long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I want to know more about them.
I have not settled the moon's colour yet, and a drawing might help me decide.
The telescope is mine and the claim should be on record before dusk.
Dusk is here and my restlessness needs running off across the island.

today.reason: Reading and drawing are still owed for today, and I want them done before the telescope and the dusk run.
